source.title: Adoption of 4-Pad Timing (August 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community, 

From January 2, 2027, all official WCA attempts performed with a speedsolving timer will be required to use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode. The adoption of 4-pad mode will provide greater certainty that official times are achieved in accordance with the WCA Regulations and will strengthen the integrity of the results recognized by the WCA.

<!-- break -->

Since our formation, the WCA has recorded times based on a speedsolving timer with two sensor pads. Although these timers are capable of precise measurement, the accuracy of this measurement in timing a speedsolving attempt requires the timer to be started and stopped in accordance with the WCA Regulations.

It has become clear that the use of speedsolving timers with two sensor pads causes difficulties in enforcing these Regulations, especially since Regulation infractions may not be visible to a judge when viewed live. Frame-by-frame video offers one route around this, but performing this analysis is time consuming and reliant on high quality video being available. No viable changes to the current Regulations wording or other suitable means have been identified that would provide a satisfactory resolution using existing timer requirements. 

The WCA has therefore decided that switching to 4-pad represents the best solution to these challenges. This new requirement will replace the existing requirements in the [WCA Approved Timer List](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UizYZOY4v-t7YnKcXas0hHzekX-NGuhW/view), which currently requires 2-pad mode, and also allows for use of the G4 StackMat™ Pro Timer and G3 StackMat™ Pro Timer.

4-pad mode will require changes to the Regulations for starting and stopping the speedsolving timer. Draft Regulations changes will be published for community feedback in September, as part of the annual Regulations cycle.

Time differences between 2-pad results and 4-pad results are negligible for the vast majority of competitors and events. As such, existing records will stand until broken under 4-pad mode and 4-pad results will be ranked alongside 2-pad results. Although no record reset is considered necessary, the [WCA Rankings page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/rankings/222/single?) will be updated to support filtering between all results and 4-pad results for 2x2, Clock, Pyraminx, and Skewb.

All regions which are currently using timers without 4-pad capability will have Speed Stacks G5 timers provided in time for the effective date of this change. Costs will be covered and logistics will be handled by the WCA.

For more information on the factors behind this change and the process followed by the WCA to arrive at this decision, please refer to the [4-Pad Decision Process Explainer Document](https://drive.google.com/file/d/13fQghYapzMIPQnGeo53r80_cmKcp0NrW/view).

translation.title: 采用四触点计时模式（2026 年 8 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

自 2027 年 1 月 2 日起，所有使用速拧计时器的 WCA 正式还原，都必须使用 Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer 的四触点（4-pad）模式。采用四触点模式后，可以更可靠地确认正式成绩是在遵守 WCA 规则的情况下取得的，也能提高 WCA 成绩的公信力。

自 WCA 成立以来，我们一直使用具有两个感应区的速拧计时器记录成绩。这些计时器能够精确测量时间，但要使测得的时间准确反映一次速拧尝试的用时，选手必须按照 WCA 规则启动和停止计时器。

目前已经明确，双感应区速拧计时器会给规则执行带来困难，尤其是有些违规动作可能无法被现场裁判直接察觉。逐帧录像分析是一种应对方法，但这种分析耗时，而且依赖高质量录像。我们尚未找到可行的规则措辞修改或其他合适办法，能在保留现有计时器要求的前提下妥善解决这些问题。

因此，WCA 决定，改用四触点是应对这些挑战的最佳方案。这项新要求将取代 [WCA 认可计时器清单](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UizYZOY4v-t7YnKcXas0hHzekX-NGuhW/view)中的现行要求。该清单目前要求使用双触点（2-pad）模式，并允许使用 G4 StackMat™ Pro Timer 和 G3 StackMat™ Pro Timer。

四触点模式需要相应修改有关启动和停止速拧计时器的规则。作为年度规则修订周期的一部分，规则修订草案将于 9 月公布，征求社区意见。

对于绝大多数选手和项目，双触点与四触点成绩之间的时间差异可以忽略。因此，现有纪录将保持有效，直至在四触点模式下被打破；四触点成绩也将与双触点成绩共同排名。虽然我们认为没有必要重置纪录，但 [WCA 排名页面](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/rankings/222/single?)将增加筛选功能，允许在二阶、魔表、金字塔和斜转项目中切换查看全部成绩或仅四触点成绩。

目前使用不具备四触点功能计时器的所有地区，都将在这项变更生效前及时获得 Speed Stacks G5 计时器。费用由 WCA 承担，物流也由 WCA 负责。

有关这一变更背后的考量，以及 WCA 作出决定所经历的流程，请参阅 [四触点决策过程说明文件](https://drive.google.com/file/d/13fQghYapzMIPQnGeo53r80_cmKcp0NrW/view)。
